'''Azure''' was a diminutive [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] at a non-strategic location where most of the landmass was taken up by a clandestine [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Azure Spaceport|spaceport]]. The planet was part of a [[Azure system (Mid Rim)/Legends|Azure system]] and had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]] nor any useful resources. It was commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Solomahal/Legends|Solomahal]] until [[Battle of Azure Spaceport|conquered]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

It was also the location of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi's]] [[Death/Legends|death]].
